description: Get the public profile of one personal trainer on UK Fitness Pro by username (the `username` from search_trainers, or the last part of a profile URL such as ukfitness.pro/jane.smith). Returns description, specialities, qualifications, training locations, pricing and a profile link. Qualifications and insurance are self-reported by the trainer; say so when repeating them. Verified means UK Fitness Pro has checked this trainer's identity documents. It does not confirm qualifications or insurance, which are as stated by the trainer. Phone numbers and email addresses are not available: users contact trainers through the enquiry form on the profile page.
name: get_trainer_profile
title: Get a trainer's profile
